exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal, assisted vaginal, and cesarean delivery)
cohort: 245 women who gave birth (spontaneous vaginal, assisted vaginal, and cesarean delivery) at SoE Rural General Hospital in East Nusa Tenggara from October to December 2022.
finding: The study found a significant discrepancy between hospital cost and INA-CBGs claim for obstetric services, with hospital costs exceeding claim costs by 67% to 158% depending on the mode of delivery and class of inpatient room.
mod_finding: Hospital cost was higher than the INA-CBGs claim for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
